title: Avatar Maker
fullDescription: This project delivered a lightweight and highly reusable WebGL avatar maker, engineered for broad application. Its core functionality empowers users to create custom avatars, which are then optimized and exported as GLB files for seamless integration across various platforms and projects. The avatar maker's successful implementation within the LandRocker universe, the Alef game, and the Du Fan Zone for FIFA 2022 showcases its adaptability and ease of integration. Featuring both male and female base models, it is engineered for smooth performance, even on mobile devices. Leveraging Unity's Addressable Assets system, it efficiently manages a wide range of customization options, from character features and clothing to specific attributes and UI icons, ensuring optimal performance. For the Alef game integration, the system automates the process of baking the final avatar, creating an optimized GLB version, exporting and uploading it, and redirecting the user to the game, where a custom loader handles the GLB file. Complementing this technical framework, a team of 10 artists was guided to create over 100 diverse assets, ensuring compatibility and contributing to a comprehensive and engaging avatar creation experience.

process.title: Sole Development in WebGL
process.description: The avatar maker was architected and developed entirely in WebGL, emphasizing a lightweight and efficient design for broad usability.

process.title: Avatar Baking and GLB Export Implementation
process.description: A robust system was engineered for baking customized avatars into an optimized format, coupled with the implementation of GLB export for universal compatibility.

process.title: Addressable Assets System Integration
process.description: Unity's Addressable Assets system was strategically integrated to ensure the efficient management and dynamic loading/unloading of an extensive array of customization options, optimizing performance.

process.title: Art Asset Management and Team Leadership
process.description: Oversight and direction were provided to a team of 10 artists in the creation of over 100 diverse avatar assets, ensuring a cohesive and high-quality visual experience.

process.title: Integration with the Alef Game
process.description: A tailored integration was developed for the Alef game, encompassing automated avatar baking, GLB export and upload, and seamless in-game loading. (Captured During Development)
